name: The Fool
full_description: The Fool stands at the edge of a cliff, gazing toward the sky, oblivious to the precipice beneath his feet. He represents the purest form of potential—the moment before a journey begins when anything is possible. This card is an invitation to embrace your inner child, to trust the universe implicitly, and to take that leap of faith even if you cannot see where you will land. It is the archetype of the wanderer, the dreamer, and the soul unburdened by the weight of the past or the fear of the future. In a reading, it suggests that you are at the start of a profound spiritual or life cycle where personal growth is inevitable if you remain open to the unknown.
upright_short_meaning: A fresh start and new adventures are on the horizon. Trust the universe.
reversed_short_meaning: Be cautious of acting impulsively or without thinking through the consequences.

love.upright: A new romantic adventure is coming. Be open to spontaneous and unconventional connections.
love.reversed: Be careful of impulsive decisions in love or falling for someone without seeing the red flags.

career.upright: A fresh start in your professional life. A new job or business opportunity is opening up.
career.reversed: Double-check the details before jumping into a new venture; you might be lacking the necessary experience.

financial.upright: Unexpected financial opportunities may arise. Stay optimistic but stay grounded.
financial.reversed: Avoid risky investments or overspending on whims that offer no long-term security.

wellbeing.upright: Energy levels are high. It's an excellent time to start a new health or fitness routine.
wellbeing.reversed: Watch out for minor accidents caused by a lack of focus or general carelessness.

name: The Magician
full_description: The Magician is the bridge between the world of spirit and the world of humanity. With one hand pointing to the heavens and the other to the earth, he represents the phrase 'as above, so below.' This card is a powerful omen of manifestation, signaling that you have all the tools—intellect, emotion, and physical resources—to turn your visions into reality. It is about the mastery of willpower and the alignment of your desires with the divine. When The Magician appears, the universe is providing you with a green light to act. You are the architect of your own destiny, and the energy around you is ripe for creation and success.
upright_short_meaning: You have everything you need to succeed. It's time to take action and manifest your goals.
reversed_short_meaning: You might be feeling blocked or using your influence for the wrong reasons. Beware of illusions.

love.upright: You have the charm and magnetic power to attract the love you desire. A very positive time for romance.
love.reversed: Be honest in your communication; someone may be using manipulation rather than true emotion.

career.upright: A great time to launch a project. You have the skills required and the drive to succeed.
career.reversed: You might be lacking the focus needed, or you are wasting your talents on the wrong path.

financial.upright: Financial manifestation is strong. Your creative efforts and hard work will pay off.
financial.reversed: Be careful of deceptive schemes, 'get rich quick' ideas, or hidden financial risks.

wellbeing.upright: Mental clarity and physical vitality are strong. Focus on holistic and intentional healing.
wellbeing.reversed: You might be experiencing stress due to feeling out of control or misusing your energy.

name: The High Priestess
full_description: The High Priestess sits at the threshold of the conscious and subconscious mind. She is the guardian of secrets and the silent observer of the soul's mysteries. Unlike The Magician who acts, The High Priestess waits and listens. She represents the divine feminine and the wisdom that comes from stillness and introspection. This card suggests that the answers you seek are not found in the external world, but within your own intuition and dreams. It is a time for patience, for looking past the surface of things, and for trusting the 'gut feelings' that defy logic. She is the whisper in the dark that guides you toward your highest truth.
upright_short_meaning: Listen to your inner voice and trust your instincts. The answers are within you.
reversed_short_meaning: You are ignoring your intuition or there are hidden secrets you aren't seeing yet.

love.upright: A deep, soulful, and perhaps psychic connection is possible. Trust your feelings about a partner.
love.reversed: Hidden secrets or repressed emotions might be causing distance in your relationship.

career.upright: Wait for the right moment. Not everything is as it seems; look for hidden information.
career.reversed: Information is being withheld from you at work. Avoid making major decisions right now.

financial.upright: Keep your financial plans private for now. Trust your intuition regarding investments.
financial.reversed: Hidden costs or fine print might cause issues later. Do your research thoroughly.

wellbeing.upright: Listen to what your body is telling you. Intuitive healing and meditation are key.
wellbeing.reversed: Ignoring symptoms or mental fatigue. You need to stop, rest, and reconnect with yourself.

name: The Empress
full_description: The Empress is the Great Mother, the embodiment of the Earth itself and all the abundance it provides. She sits on a throne surrounded by lush nature, representing the birth of ideas, beauty, and life. This card is a sign of immense creativity and the nurturing power required to bring projects or relationships to fruition. She encourages you to connect with your senses—to appreciate art, good food, and the beauty of the natural world. The Empress reminds you that you are worthy of luxury and comfort. Whether it's a physical birth or the birth of a new creative venture, her presence promises growth, harmony, and material stability.
upright_short_meaning: A time of growth, abundance, and creativity. Nurture yourself and your ideas.
reversed_short_meaning: You may be struggling with a creative block or neglecting your own needs for others.

love.upright: A period of deep romance and nurturing love. Could signal a stable, long-term commitment.
love.reversed: Possessiveness or lack of self-love may be straining your romantic connections.

career.upright: Your creative projects will thrive. A nurturing environment at work leads to success.
career.reversed: Work may feel uninspiring or you are feeling overwhelmed by a lack of progress.

financial.upright: Financial security and abundance are flowing toward you. A good time for growth.
financial.reversed: Be careful of overspending on luxuries to fill an emotional void.

wellbeing.upright: Vitality is high. A great time for self-care, spa treatments, or grounding in nature.
wellbeing.reversed: Low energy or feeling disconnected from your body. Focus on nourishing yourself.

name: The Emperor
full_description: The Emperor is the archetype of the Divine Masculine—the ruler, the protector, and the provider. He sits on a stone throne decorated with rams' heads, symbolizing leadership and determination. This card represents the need for structure, logic, and order in your life. Where The Empress is about the flow of nature, The Emperor is about the establishment of law and boundaries. He calls you to step into your power, to take charge of your circumstances, and to lead with a firm but fair hand. It is a message that success will come through discipline, strategy, and a solid foundation rather than through emotion or chaos.
upright_short_meaning: Establish order and take control. Logic and discipline will lead you to success.
reversed_short_meaning: Avoid being overly controlling or rigid. A lack of structure may lead to failure.

love.upright: A stable, structured, and protective relationship. Logic plays a part in your love life.
love.reversed: Power struggles or an overbearing partner may be causing tension in the bond.

career.upright: Promotion or a position of authority. Your leadership skills are being recognized.
career.reversed: A difficult boss or a lack of career direction is making things feel chaotic.

financial.upright: Solid financial planning and discipline. Your wealth is stable and growing.
financial.reversed: Poor money management or a lack of control over your spending habits.

wellbeing.upright: A disciplined health routine will bring results. Strength and resilience are key.
wellbeing.reversed: Over-exerting yourself or ignoring a structured health plan. Don't be too hard on yourself.

name: The Hierophant
full_description: The Hierophant serves as the guardian of tradition and the interpreter of sacred knowledge. He represents established systems, whether they be religious, educational, or social. This card suggests that you may find guidance and wisdom by sticking to proven methods or seeking advice from a mentor or institution. It is about the shared values of a community and the importance of ceremony and structure in spiritual growth. While The High Priestess explores the inner world, The Hierophant teaches the outer, formal paths to knowledge. It is a call to learn the rules before you decide to break them and to honor the heritage that came before you.
upright_short_meaning: Seek guidance from traditional sources or mentors. Honor established systems.
reversed_short_meaning: Time to break the rules and forge your own path. Challenge the status quo.

love.upright: A traditional relationship or marriage. Shared values and beliefs are important.
love.reversed: A relationship that defies social norms or a disagreement over core values.

career.upright: Success within a large organization or school. Follow the established protocols.
career.reversed: Feeling restricted by bureaucracy; you may want to start your own unconventional business.

financial.upright: Stick to traditional, low-risk investments. Save money through proven methods.
financial.reversed: Taking a financial risk or investing in something unconventional and new.

wellbeing.upright: Traditional medicine and routine check-ups are advised. Stick to a proven diet.
wellbeing.reversed: Exploring alternative healing methods or breaking away from a standard health routine.

name: The Lovers
full_description: The Lovers represent the union of dualities—masculine and feminine, conscious and subconscious, heart and mind. While often associated with romantic love, this card is fundamentally about choice and alignment. It signifies a crossroads where you must decide what truly matters to you and what your core values are. The angel Raphael hovers above the couple, suggesting a divine blessing on a union or a decision made with integrity. This card asks you to act from a place of love and harmony rather than fear. It is about finding wholeness through another person or through the integration of different aspects of your own self.
upright_short_meaning: Harmony in relationships and important choices. Align with your true values.
reversed_short_meaning: Inner conflict or a lack of harmony in a partnership. Re-evaluate your choices.

love.upright: A beautiful, balanced partnership. Deep connection and mutual attraction.
love.reversed: A misalignment of values or a relationship that is out of balance. Communication is failing.

career.upright: A successful business partnership or a choice between two career paths you enjoy.
career.reversed: Conflict at work or a difficult decision that may lead to a loss of harmony in the office.

financial.upright: A decision regarding money that requires balance. Possible joint financial venture.
financial.reversed: Irresponsible spending or a financial choice made for the wrong emotional reasons.

wellbeing.upright: Finding balance between mental and physical health. Harmony in your body.
wellbeing.reversed: Physical imbalance or emotional stress impacting your health. Seek harmony within.

name: The Chariot
full_description: The Chariot is a symbol of triumph through sheer willpower and discipline. The figure in the chariot does not use reins; instead, he controls the two opposing sphinxes with his mind and his wand. This signifies that victory comes not from brute force, but from the mastery of conflicting internal emotions and external obstacles. It is a card of movement and fast-paced energy. When The Chariot appears, it is a call to maintain your focus, stay determined, and steer your life with confidence. You are being encouraged to overcome challenges by asserting your ego and staying true to your destination, regardless of the distractions along the way.
upright_short_meaning: Success is within reach if you maintain focus and self-discipline. Keep moving forward.
reversed_short_meaning: You may feel like you’ve lost control of a situation. Re-evaluate your direction.

love.upright: A time to take charge of your love life. It may indicate a whirlwind romance or overcoming relationship hurdles together.
love.reversed: An obsession with control might be damaging your relationship. Slow down and communicate.

career.upright: High ambition and drive will lead to a major breakthrough. You are in the driver's seat of your career.
career.reversed: You might be pushing too hard or lack the necessary plan to reach your professional goals.

financial.upright: Fast financial progress is possible. A good time to overcome debts or financial obstacles.
financial.reversed: Impulsive spending or rushing into a large purchase without thinking it through.

wellbeing.upright: You have the motivation to conquer health issues. Physical strength and stamina are high.
wellbeing.reversed: Burnout from pushing yourself too hard. You need to find a balance between effort and rest.

name: Strength
full_description: Strength is not represented by a warrior in armor, but by a woman calmly taming a powerful lion. This card emphasizes that true power lies in 'soft' control—patience, love, and quiet fortitude. It is the ability to face life's fiercest challenges with a calm heart and an iron will. Strength suggests that you have the inner resilience to endure any hardship without losing your kindness. It is about mastering your animal instincts and choosing grace over aggression. When this card appears, it reminds you that you are much stronger than you give yourself credit for, and that your persistence will eventually quiet the roars of doubt within you.
upright_short_meaning: Face your fears with courage and compassion. Inner strength is your greatest asset.
reversed_short_meaning: You may be feeling vulnerable or lacking the confidence to stand up for yourself.

love.upright: A relationship built on mutual respect and emotional maturity. Compassion will heal any rift.
love.reversed: Insecurity or emotional outbursts may be causing friction. Work on your self-esteem first.

career.upright: Your quiet confidence is earning you respect. You can influence others through persuasion rather than force.
career.reversed: You might be doubting your abilities at work. Don't let imposter syndrome hold you back.

financial.upright: Controlled spending and financial resilience. You have the discipline to reach your savings goals.
financial.reversed: Compulsive financial decisions driven by fear or a lack of self-control.

wellbeing.upright: Vitality is returning. A focus on mental and physical endurance will bring long-term health.
wellbeing.reversed: Physical or emotional exhaustion. You need to nurture your spirit to regain your strength.

name: The Hermit
full_description: The Hermit stands alone on a mountain peak, holding a lantern that contains a six-pointed star. He represents the path of the seeker—someone who turns away from the noise of the material world to find the truth within. This card is an invitation to take a step back and enter a period of introspection. It is not a time for social action, but for spiritual reflection. The Hermit knows that the wisdom you seek cannot be taught by others; it must be discovered through silence and solitude. He is the light in the darkness, showing you that by knowing yourself, you will eventually find the way forward in the outer world.
upright_short_meaning: Take time for self-reflection. The answers you seek are found in the stillness.
reversed_short_meaning: You may be isolating yourself too much or avoiding the truth about a situation.

love.upright: A period of reflection about what you truly want in a partner. Taking a break from dating to heal.
love.reversed: Loneliness in a relationship or being too emotionally withdrawn from your partner.

career.upright: Evaluating your career path. You may need to seek advice from a mentor or take a sabbatical.
career.reversed: Feeling disconnected from your work or ignoring valuable professional advice.

financial.upright: A time to be cautious and wise with money. Material wealth is not your priority right now.
financial.reversed: Missing financial details because you're too focused on the wrong things. Re-engage with your budget.

wellbeing.upright: Rest and meditation are essential. Your soul needs as much care as your body.
wellbeing.reversed: Neglecting your mental health through excessive isolation or overthinking.

name: Wheel of Fortune
full_description: The Wheel of Fortune reminds us that life is in a constant state of flux. Nothing stays the same forever—the only constant is change. This card represents the cycles of the universe and the hand of fate. When the wheel turns in your favor, you experience breakthroughs and sudden strokes of luck. However, it also serves as a reminder to stay humble during the highs, as the wheel will inevitably turn again. It is a highly karmic card, suggesting that what you have sown, you shall now reap. It encourages you to lean into the changes rather than fighting them, trusting that the universe has a grand design for your evolution.
upright_short_meaning: A turning point is coming. Trust the timing of your life and embrace the change.
reversed_short_meaning: You are struggling against inevitable changes. Let go of what you cannot control.

love.upright: A fated meeting or a positive shift in your relationship. Luck is on your side.
love.reversed: External factors are disrupting your love life. It feels like bad timing for romance.

career.upright: A sudden promotion or a new opportunity. A lucky break in your professional journey.
career.reversed: Unexpected setbacks or delays in your career. This cycle will pass; stay patient.

financial.upright: Financial luck is improving. An unexpected gain or a positive turn in your investments.
financial.reversed: Financial instability or a sudden expense. Be careful with your resources during this dip.

wellbeing.upright: A positive change in health. Your energy is aligning with the natural cycles of the earth.
wellbeing.reversed: Temporary health setbacks. Don't fight the need for rest; adapt to your body's rhythm.

name: Justice
full_description: Justice sits before a purple veil, holding a sword in one hand and scales in the other. She represents the objective truth and the law of karma—every action has a consequence. This card is about balance and accountability. It suggests that a situation will be resolved fairly and that the truth will ultimately come to light. Justice is not interested in emotions or excuses; she looks only at the facts. If you have been wronged, this card promises vindication. If you have done wrong, it calls for you to take responsibility. It is a reminder to act with integrity and to ensure that your life is in equilibrium.
upright_short_meaning: Truth will prevail. Be honest and take responsibility for your actions.
reversed_short_meaning: Injustice or a refusal to see the truth. You may be avoiding consequences.

love.upright: A relationship that is fair and balanced. If you are single, you will attract what you give out.
love.reversed: Unfair treatment in love or a lack of balance between partners. Someone is being dishonest.

career.upright: Contracts, legal matters, or disputes will be settled in a fair way. Hard work is rewarded.
career.reversed: Unfair criticism at work or a lack of accountability for a mistake. Watch out for legal snags.

financial.upright: Legal financial matters are resolved. A balanced budget leads to peace of mind.
financial.reversed: Unfair financial dealings or a warning to be more honest about your spending habits.

wellbeing.upright: Restoring balance to your health. Your body is reacting directly to your lifestyle choices.
wellbeing.reversed: An imbalance in your life is affecting your health. You need to address the root cause.

name: The Hanged Man
full_description: The Hanged Man hangs upside down from a T-shaped tree, but his expression is peaceful, and a halo shines around his head. He represents the paradox of finding power through surrender. Sometimes, the only way to move forward is to stop completely. This card suggests a voluntary pause—a time to look at the world from a different angle. It often requires a sacrifice of something old to gain a new spiritual insight. It is not a card of suffering, but of suspended animation, where you wait for the right moment to act. The Hanged Man teaches us that by letting go of our need to control, we actually gain the clarity we need to succeed.
upright_short_meaning: Pause and look at things from a new perspective. Surrender to the present moment.
reversed_short_meaning: You are resisting a necessary pause or feeling stuck in a stalemate. Stop stalling.

love.upright: Taking a step back to see your relationship clearly. Patience is required right now.
love.reversed: Feeling stuck in a stagnant relationship. You might be making unnecessary sacrifices.

career.upright: A temporary delay in plans. Use this time to brainstorm and refine your strategy.
career.reversed: Procrastination or feeling like your career is at a dead end. You're waiting without a purpose.

financial.upright: A period of financial waiting. Avoid making major moves; just observe and plan.
financial.reversed: Wasting resources on a situation that isn't moving. A sacrifice that doesn't pay off.

wellbeing.upright: A time for rest and recovery. Viewing your health challenges from a new angle.
wellbeing.reversed: Ignoring the need for a break. Your body is forcing you to slow down, but you are resisting.

name: Death
full_description: Death is perhaps the most misunderstood card in the Tarot. It rarely represents physical death; instead, it signals the end of a major phase or aspect of your life that is no longer serving you. A skeletal knight rides a white horse, symbolizing that death comes to everyone, regardless of rank. This card is about the necessity of endings to make room for new beginnings. It is the 'winter' of the soul—a period where you must let go of the old self to be reborn. When Death appears, it is a powerful message to stop resisting the inevitable and to embrace the transformation that is taking place. Only by clearing away the dead wood can new growth emerge.
upright_short_meaning: A major phase of your life is ending. Embrace the change and prepare for a rebirth.
reversed_short_meaning: You are clinging to the past and resisting a necessary transition. Let go to move forward.

love.upright: A significant shift in a relationship or the end of a partnership that has run its course.
love.reversed: Holding onto a dead relationship out of fear or failing to change old habits that hurt your bond.

career.upright: A career transition, leaving a job, or the conclusion of a major project. A fresh start awaits.
career.reversed: Staying in a stagnant job because you fear the unknown. You are delaying the inevitable.

financial.upright: A change in your financial status. You may need to let go of old spending habits to survive.
financial.reversed: Financial loss due to an inability to adapt to new circumstances. Stop the drain.

wellbeing.upright: A transformation in your health. Shedding old, unhealthy patterns for a new lifestyle.
wellbeing.reversed: Refusing to acknowledge a health issue or staying stuck in a cycle of poor recovery.

name: Temperance
full_description: Temperance depicts an angel pouring liquid between two golden cups, representing the alchemy of life. This card is about finding the 'middle way' and practicing extreme patience. It suggests that you are learning to bring balance to your emotions and your external circumstances. Temperance is the calm after the storm of Death; it is the integration of opposites into a harmonious whole. It calls for moderation in all things—avoiding extremes and staying grounded. When this card appears, it is a sign that you are on the right path to spiritual and emotional health, provided you stay calm and act with purpose rather than impulse.
upright_short_meaning: Find balance and harmony in your life. Practice patience and moderation in all things.
reversed_short_meaning: You are living in extremes. Re-evaluate your choices and find your center again.

love.upright: A harmonious, balanced relationship built on mutual understanding and calm communication.
love.reversed: Conflict caused by a lack of balance. One partner may be giving too much or acting erratically.

career.upright: Stability at work. You are successfully balancing different tasks and maintaining a steady pace.
career.reversed: Work-life imbalance or rushing through projects without quality control. Slow down.

financial.upright: A balanced budget and careful money management. Financial peace through moderation.
financial.reversed: Imbalance in spending. You might be using 'retail therapy' to solve emotional issues.

wellbeing.upright: Good health through a balanced diet and lifestyle. Your energy is in equilibrium.
wellbeing.reversed: Physical issues caused by excess—whether it's overworking, overeating, or lack of sleep.

name: The Devil
full_description: The Devil represents the darker side of the human experience—the chains we forge ourselves through addiction, materialism, and negative thought patterns. He sits above two figures who are chained to his pedestal, yet if you look closely, the chains are loose. They could leave at any time, but they choose to stay. This card is a mirror to your shadow self, showing you where you are enslaved by your own desires or fears. It is about the illusion of being trapped. The Devil asks you to identify the 'vices' or toxic cycles that are holding you back and to realize that you hold the key to your own liberation.
upright_short_meaning: You are feeling trapped by your own habits or attachments. Break the chains of the ego.
reversed_short_meaning: You are beginning to see the truth and are ready to break free from toxic cycles.

love.upright: An intense, perhaps obsessive or toxic attraction. Codependency is a major theme here.
love.reversed: Breaking free from a toxic relationship or realizing that a bond was based on lust rather than love.

career.upright: Feeling trapped in a job you hate or being overly focused on status and money at any cost.
career.reversed: Regaining control over your professional life and letting go of a job that was soul-crushing.

financial.upright: Debt, overspending, or being 'owned' by your material possessions. Financial slavery.
financial.reversed: Paying off debts and realizing that money doesn't define your worth. Freedom from greed.

wellbeing.upright: Issues with addiction or unhealthy physical habits. You are neglecting your spiritual health.
wellbeing.reversed: Recovering from a bad habit or addiction. Choosing health over temporary pleasure.

name: The Tower
full_description: The Tower is a card of sudden, shocking change. Lightening strikes a tall tower, crumbling its foundations and sending its inhabitants falling. This represents the destruction of structures built on false pretenses or weak foundations. While it feels terrifying, The Tower is actually a blessing in disguise—it clears away the lies and illusions that were holding you back. It is a 'forced' awakening. When The Tower appears, expect the unexpected. A truth will be revealed, a system will break, or a situation will collapse. It is the universe's way of saying that you cannot build a healthy future on a broken past.
upright_short_meaning: A sudden upheaval is coming. Let the old structures fall so you can build something true.
reversed_short_meaning: You are avoiding a necessary crisis. The collapse is coming; don't fight it.

love.upright: A sudden breakup or a shocking revelation about a partner. The relationship's foundation is tested.
love.reversed: A relationship that is falling apart slowly. You are trying to avoid the inevitable split.

career.upright: Sudden job loss, a failed project, or a massive shift in company structure. Expect chaos.
career.reversed: Narrowly avoiding a disaster at work, but the underlying issues are still present.

financial.upright: A financial shock or a sudden loss of income. A warning to prepare for the worst.
financial.reversed: Financial instability that you are trying to hide. A temporary reprieve from bankruptcy.

wellbeing.upright: A sudden illness or injury that forces you to change your life. A wake-up call for your health.
wellbeing.reversed: Ignoring symptoms of a brewing health crisis. You are avoiding a necessary medical visit.

name: The Star
full_description: After the chaos of The Tower, The Star arrives as a beacon of hope and healing. A woman kneels by a pool, pouring water back into the earth and the water, symbolizing a continuous flow of inspiration and spiritual renewal. This card represents a period of calm and clarity after a time of struggle. It is a reminder that you are protected by the universe and that your soul is being restored. The Star doesn't offer practical solutions; it offers the faith and vision needed to keep going. It is a sign that you are entering a time of peace, where your inner light will shine brighter than ever before.
upright_short_meaning: Hope and healing are here. Trust your path and keep your faith in the future.
reversed_short_meaning: You are feeling hopeless or disconnected from your purpose. Seek the light within.

love.upright: A time of healing in your love life. If you are single, a soulful connection is on the horizon.
love.reversed: Feeling discouraged about love. You may have lost faith in finding the right partner.

career.upright: Inspiration is returning to your work. Your creative projects are blessed with success.
career.reversed: A lack of motivation or a feeling that your career goals are out of reach. Stay inspired.

financial.upright: Financial hope is restored. You are moving toward a time of stability and abundance.
financial.reversed: Pessimism regarding money. You feel like you'll never reach your financial goals.

wellbeing.upright: Deep emotional and physical healing. Your energy is being replenished by the universe.
wellbeing.reversed: Mental fatigue or a lack of spiritual connection. You need to reconnect with your 'why'.

name: The Moon
full_description: The Moon represents the realm of shadows, dreams, and the subconscious. It is a card of mystery where things are not as they seem. Under the moonlight, familiar paths look strange, and hidden fears emerge from the water. This card suggests that you may be experiencing confusion or anxiety, perhaps because you are dealing with illusions or half-truths. It is a call to trust your intuition over your logic, as the 'dark' part of your mind knows things your conscious mind does not. The Moon warns you to be careful of deception and to wait until the sun rises before making major decisions.
upright_short_meaning: Things are not what they seem. Trust your intuition to guide you through the darkness.
reversed_short_meaning: The fog is lifting. Truths are being revealed and your fears are subsiding.

love.upright: Uncertainty or hidden secrets in a relationship. One partner may be hiding their true feelings.
love.reversed: A period of confusion in love is ending. Misunderstandings are finally cleared up.

career.upright: A lack of clarity in your career path. Beware of office politics or hidden agendas.
career.reversed: Seeing the truth about a work situation. A confusing project finally becomes clear.

financial.upright: Hidden risks in investments. Be careful of financial deals that sound too good to be true.
financial.reversed: Discovering a financial error or seeing through a deceptive money scheme.

wellbeing.upright: Mental health struggles or vivid, confusing dreams. Your subconscious is trying to speak.
wellbeing.reversed: Recovering from anxiety or mental fog. A return to clarity and emotional stability.

name: The Sun
full_description: The Sun is the most positive card in the Tarot deck. A large, bright sun shines over a child riding a white horse, symbolizing the pure joy and innocence of the human spirit. This card represents a time of absolute clarity, success, and abundance. Everything is coming into the light, and the obstacles that once seemed insurmountable have vanished. The Sun brings vitality and warmth to every area of your life—relationships, health, and career. It is a reminder that you are radiant and capable of achieving greatness. When this card appears, it is a sign that you are being blessed with the energy to manifest your highest potential and celebrate your achievements.
upright_short_meaning: Success and happiness are yours. Everything is becoming clear and bright.
reversed_short_meaning: You are struggling to see the bright side. Reconnect with your inner child and joy.

love.upright: A period of great joy, passion, and transparency in love. A very happy partnership.
love.reversed: Small clouds are blocking your happiness. You may be taking your partner for granted.

career.upright: Excellence and recognition at work. You are shining in your field and reaching your goals.
career.reversed: Success is delayed or you are feeling uninspired. You need to regain your confidence.

financial.upright: Financial abundance and stability. Your investments and hard work are bearing fruit.
financial.reversed: Temporary financial worries that are not as bad as they seem. Stay optimistic.

wellbeing.upright: Radiant health and high energy. You are feeling physically and mentally vibrant.
wellbeing.reversed: A slight dip in energy or health. You need more sunlight, literally and metaphorically.

name: Judgement
full_description: Judgement depicts the Archangel Gabriel blowing a trumpet, calling souls to rise from their graves. This is not a card of punishment, but of awakening and transformation. It represents a 'reckoning' where you look back at your past actions with honesty and clarity. You are being called to a higher purpose—to shed the old skin and embrace a new way of being. This card suggests that a major life decision is required, one that will lead to a spiritual rebirth. It is about forgiveness, both for yourself and others, and the realization that you have a second chance to create the life you truly desire. The 'call' is loud; you cannot ignore it anymore.
upright_short_meaning: A spiritual awakening or a major life decision. It’s time to answer your higher calling.
reversed_short_meaning: You are ignoring a call for change. Stop doubting yourself and take the next step.

love.upright: A turning point in a relationship. A time for honest conversation and mutual growth.
love.reversed: Avoiding a necessary decision in love. You are letting past mistakes haunt your present.

career.upright: Your hard work is being evaluated. A promotion or a total career shift based on your true passion.
career.reversed: Feeling judged or stuck at work. You are refusing to learn from your past professional errors.

financial.upright: Reviewing your financial habits. A time to clear old debts and start fresh with a better plan.
financial.reversed: Financial stagnation because you are repeating the same mistakes over and over.

wellbeing.upright: A recovery from long-term illness or a total transformation of your lifestyle and health.
wellbeing.reversed: Ignoring your body's signals for change. You need to stop making excuses for poor habits.

name: The World
full_description: The World is the final card of the Major Arcana, representing the end of a long and difficult journey. A figure dances inside a laurel wreath, symbolizing victory and the successful integration of all life lessons. You have reached a state of wholeness and completion. This card marks a time where you are in perfect harmony with the universe. You have achieved your goals, and you are ready to enjoy the fruits of your labor. The World also suggests travel—literally or metaphorically—as your horizons have expanded beyond what you once thought possible. It is the 'Master' card, showing that you have completed one cycle and are ready to begin the next on a much higher level.
upright_short_meaning: Success, completion, and wholeness. You have achieved your goal and the world is yours.
reversed_short_meaning: You are near the end but haven't quite finished. Don't take shortcuts; seek closure.

love.upright: A relationship reaching a state of fulfillment. Marriage or a deep sense of shared purpose.
love.reversed: A lack of closure from a past relationship or feeling that something is missing in your bond.

career.upright: Achieving your ultimate career goal. Recognition on a global or wide-reaching scale.
career.reversed: A project is almost done but needs a final push. You are feeling unfulfilled despite success.

financial.upright: Total financial security and the successful completion of a long-term investment goal.
financial.reversed: Financial goals are within reach but not yet secured. Don't stop working hard now.

wellbeing.upright: Peak physical and mental health. A feeling of being 'whole' and in tune with your body.
wellbeing.reversed: A sense of incompletion in your health journey. You need to finish what you started (like a detox).

name: Ace of Cups
full_description: The Ace of Cups shows a hand emerging from the clouds holding a cup that overflows with five streams of water. It represents the vessel of your soul, overflowing with spiritual and emotional abundance. This card is a beautiful omen of new beginnings in the realm of the heart. It suggests that a new wellspring of love, creativity, or compassion is opening up for you. It is the purest state of emotion, free from the baggage of the past. When this card appears, it invites you to open your heart to the universe, to trust your intuition, and to allow yourself to feel deeply without fear.
upright_short_meaning: A new wave of love or emotional fulfillment is coming. Open your heart.
reversed_short_meaning: You may be feeling emotionally drained. Focus on self-love and healing within.

love.upright: A new romance or a deep emotional connection. Your heart is ready to give and receive love.
love.reversed: Blocked emotions or a feeling of being unloved. You need to nurture yourself first.

career.upright: A creative project that brings you joy. You are finding emotional satisfaction in your work.
career.reversed: Feeling uninspired or emotionally disconnected from your job. Your creativity is blocked.

financial.upright: Good news regarding finances, often linked to creative ventures or emotional support.
financial.reversed: An emotional decision regarding money that may lead to disappointment. Stay objective.

wellbeing.upright: Emotional balance and spiritual peace. Your vitality is linked to your inner happiness.
wellbeing.reversed: Suppressed feelings are affecting your health. It's time for an emotional release.

name: Two of Cups
full_description: The Two of Cups depicts a pair of lovers exchanging cups in a symbolic ceremony. Above them is the Caduceus of Hermes and a lion's head, signifying that this union is balanced, powerful, and blessed by a higher energy. This card represents the beauty of a dual connection—where two souls come together in perfect harmony. It is about mutual respect and the 'alchemy' that happens when two people align their values and emotions. Whether in romance or business, this card signals a healthy, balanced partnership where both parties feel seen, heard, and valued.
upright_short_meaning: A harmonious partnership is forming. Connection and mutual respect are key.
reversed_short_meaning: A lack of balance or harmony in a relationship. Communication is breaking down.

love.upright: Deep romantic attraction and a balanced relationship. A perfect match.
love.reversed: Argument, misunderstanding, or a temporary split. The balance of the union is lost.

career.upright: A successful business partnership or a great rapport with a colleague.
career.reversed: Conflict at work or a partnership that is no longer mutually beneficial.

financial.upright: Financial stability through a joint venture or a fair agreement.
financial.reversed: Financial disagreements or a contract that is not in your favor.

wellbeing.upright: Good health through emotional support. Your relationships are helping you heal.
wellbeing.reversed: Stress from a difficult relationship is impacting your physical health.

name: Three of Cups
full_description: In the Three of Cups, three women raise their glasses in a toast, surrounded by a bountiful harvest. This card is the ultimate symbol of community, sisterhood, and shared joy. It suggests a time to celebrate your achievements with the people who support you most. It is about the 'circles' of life—friends, family, and collaborators who make the journey worthwhile. The energy is light, festive, and full of gratitude. This card reminds you that you don't have to do it all alone; there is strength and healing in numbers and in the simple act of coming together to celebrate life's beauty.
upright_short_meaning: Time to celebrate with friends and family. Joy is found in your community.
reversed_short_meaning: You may be feeling left out or overindulging in social activities. Find your focus.

love.upright: A happy social event or a blossoming romance within your social circle.
love.reversed: A third party may be causing issues, or you are prioritizing friends over your partner.

career.upright: Success in a team project. A supportive and creative work environment.
career.reversed: Office politics or a lack of teamwork is preventing a project from succeeding.

financial.upright: Spending money on celebrations and group activities. Financial sharing.
financial.reversed: Overspending on social life or group ventures that don't pay off.

wellbeing.upright: Emotional health is boosted by social connection. A time of vitality.
wellbeing.reversed: Health issues caused by too much partying or neglect of your routine.

name: Four of Cups
full_description: The Four of Cups shows a young man sitting under a tree, his arms crossed in a defensive and bored posture. He is so focused on the three cups before him—perhaps symbols of past disappointments—that he fails to notice a fourth cup being offered by a hand in the sky. This card represents emotional stagnation and apathy. It suggests that you are feeling uninspired or 'stuck' in your current circumstances, refusing to see the new opportunities the universe is providing. It is a call to look within and ask why you are withdrawing. Are you truly dissatisfied, or are you just refusing to be grateful for what is being offered?
upright_short_meaning: Don't miss out on new opportunities because you're focused on the past.
reversed_short_meaning: You are coming out of a period of stagnation. You're ready to engage with life again.

love.upright: Feeling bored or uninspired in love. You may be ignoring a new romantic offer.
love.reversed: A new interest in dating or a renewed spark in your current relationship.

career.upright: Feeling unfulfilled at work. You are ignoring new projects or paths for growth.
career.reversed: A shift in perspective that allows you to see the value in your current job.

financial.upright: Ignoring financial advice or opportunities because you are feeling pessimistic.
financial.reversed: Taking a proactive approach to your finances after a period of neglect.

wellbeing.upright: Low energy and mental fatigue. You are feeling disconnected from your body.
wellbeing.reversed: Energy is returning. You are taking steps to improve your mental health.

name: Five of Cups
full_description: The Five of Cups is a card of mourning. A figure in a black cloak looks down at three spilled cups, devastated by the loss. However, behind them stand two cups that are still full. The figure is so consumed by regret and sadness that they cannot see the potential that remains. This card is a profound lesson on perspective. It acknowledges that grief and disappointment are real, but it warns against staying in that state for too long. It asks you to turn around and see what is still standing. The bridge in the background leads to a safe castle, suggesting that while the loss is heavy, you are not trapped; you can still cross over to a brighter future.
upright_short_meaning: Focus on what you still have, not just on what you've lost. Healing takes time.
reversed_short_meaning: You are starting to heal and see the positive side of things again. Let go of regret.

love.upright: Heartbreak or a focus on past relationship failures. You are struggling to let go.
love.reversed: Forgiving an ex or moving past a difficult phase in your relationship.

career.upright: A setback at work or a failed project. You are feeling discouraged and defeated.
career.reversed: Learning from a professional failure and preparing to try again with a new plan.

financial.upright: Financial loss or a bad investment. You are dwelling on the money you lost.
financial.reversed: Financial recovery is beginning. You are finding new ways to rebuild your wealth.

wellbeing.upright: Emotional distress affecting your vitality. You may be suffering from deep sadness.
wellbeing.reversed: Emotional healing. You are finally allowing yourself to move past the pain.

name: Six of Cups
full_description: The Six of Cups transports us to a place of nostalgia and childhood memories. Two children in a garden exchange a cup filled with flowers, symbolizing the purity of giving and receiving without hidden agendas. This card represents a return to a simpler time. It may suggest that someone from your past is returning, or that you need to reconnect with your 'inner child' to find the joy you've lost. It is a gentle, sentimental card that honors the roots from which you grew. While it is beautiful to remember, it also serves as a reminder to take that same innocence and kindness into your present-day adult life.
upright_short_meaning: A happy connection to the past. Embrace your inner child and simple joys.
reversed_short_meaning: You are too focused on 'the good old days.' It's time to live in the present.

love.upright: An old flame may return, or you are experiencing a very pure, sweet kind of love.
love.reversed: Issues from childhood are affecting your current relationship. Time to outgrow them.

career.upright: Returning to an old job or using a skill you learned long ago. A harmonious workplace.
career.reversed: Feeling stuck in an outdated career path. You need to innovate and look forward.

financial.upright: Inheritance, gifts from family, or financial support from someone in your past.
financial.reversed: Struggling to manage money because of old, childish spending habits.

wellbeing.upright: Revisiting a health routine that worked for you in the past. Feeling youthful.
wellbeing.reversed: Focusing on past traumas. You need to release the past to heal your present body.

name: Seven of Cups
full_description: The Seven of Cups shows a figure standing before seven clouds, each holding a cup filled with different visions—riches, snakes, jewels, and monsters. This is the card of many choices, but not all of them are real. It represents the confusion that comes with having too many options or being lost in a world of 'what ifs.' It warns that while dreaming is important, you cannot stay in the clouds forever. Some of these cups offer true fulfillment, while others are mere illusions that will lead to disappointment. It is a call to ground yourself, filter out the noise of your fantasies, and make a decision based on reality and your core values.
upright_short_meaning: You have many options, but choose carefully. Not all that glitters is gold.
reversed_short_meaning: The fog is lifting. You are finally ready to make a firm choice and face reality.

love.upright: Many romantic options or being in love with an idealized version of someone.
love.reversed: Seeing a partner for who they truly are. Choosing commitment over fantasy.

career.upright: Too many projects or career paths to choose from. You are feeling overwhelmed.
career.reversed: Narrowing down your goals and choosing the most realistic path to success.

financial.upright: Risky financial 'dreams' or scams. Be careful of get-rich-quick schemes.
financial.reversed: Making a solid, realistic financial plan and avoiding tempting but empty investments.

wellbeing.upright: Confusion about health choices or ignoring physical reality for a fantasy.
wellbeing.reversed: Gaining clarity on your health needs. Choosing a practical diet or routine.

name: Eight of Cups
full_description: The Eight of Cups depicts a figure walking away from eight stacked cups, heading toward a dark mountain under a crescent moon. Despite the emotional investment represented by the cups, the figure realizes that they are no longer enough. This card is about the brave decision to leave something behind—even if it's comfortable—because it no longer serves your soul's growth. It is a card of seeking something deeper and more meaningful. It marks a turning point where you choose to stop trying to fix what is broken and instead walk toward the unknown in search of your true purpose. It is a quiet, somber, but necessary journey of the spirit.
upright_short_meaning: It's time to walk away from what no longer serves you. Seek a deeper meaning.
reversed_short_meaning: You are afraid to leave a situation that is making you unhappy. Don't be stuck.

love.upright: Leaving a relationship that is no longer fulfilling. Choosing your own peace.
love.reversed: Staying in a dead-end relationship because you fear being alone or changing.

career.upright: Quitting a job or project that no longer inspires you. Seeking a new vocation.
career.reversed: Staying in a soul-crushing job because of financial security or fear of the unknown.

financial.upright: Walking away from an investment that is failing. Choosing to cut your losses.
financial.reversed: Pouring more money into a situation that is already dead. Refusing to let go.

wellbeing.upright: A period of solitude to heal. Walking away from toxic habits or environments.
wellbeing.reversed: Ignoring the need for a lifestyle change. You are drifting without a health goal.

name: Nine of Cups
full_description: Commonly known as the 'Wish Card,' the Nine of Cups shows a man sitting contentedly with nine cups arranged behind him. His arms are crossed in satisfaction, representing that he has achieved everything he desired. This card is about emotional and material fulfillment. It suggests that your hard work and positive intentions have paid off, and you are now in a position to enjoy the rewards. It is a card of luxury, comfort, and sensory pleasure. The Nine of Cups invites you to indulge in your success and to be grateful for the abundance in your life. It is a sign that you have reached a plateau of happiness where you feel 'complete' within yourself.
upright_short_meaning: Your wish is coming true. Enjoy the abundance and satisfaction you've earned.
reversed_short_meaning: You may have what you wanted, but you still feel empty. Avoid overindulgence.

love.upright: A very happy and fulfilling relationship. Your romantic wishes are granted.
love.reversed: Surface-level happiness. You may be in a relationship for the wrong reasons.

career.upright: Reaching a major milestone. You are respected and successful in your field.
career.reversed: Overconfidence or arrogance at work. You are ignoring areas that still need growth.

financial.upright: Financial prosperity and the ability to enjoy luxury. A period of great comfort.
financial.reversed: Spending for status rather than joy. Material greed is making you feel unfulfilled.

wellbeing.upright: Excellent health and physical vitality. You are feeling good in your own skin.
wellbeing.reversed: Health issues caused by excess eating, drinking, or lack of self-discipline.

name: Ten of Cups
full_description: The Ten of Cups is the ultimate card of emotional completion. A happy couple and their children stand under a rainbow made of ten golden cups. This card represents the 'happily ever after'—a state of divine love and total harmony within the home and family. It is about finding peace not just in yourself, but in your relationships with others. It suggests that you are in perfect alignment with your soul's purpose and the people around you. When this card appears, it is a blessing on your domestic life, promising that the love you give will be returned to you tenfold. It is the realization that true wealth is found in the joy of those you love.
upright_short_meaning: Total emotional and family harmony. You are surrounded by love and peace.
reversed_short_meaning: Conflict or tension in your family life. Something is out of alignment at home.

love.upright: A deep, soulful commitment. Possibly marriage, children, or a long-term happy union.
love.reversed: Disputes about family values or a feeling of being disconnected from your partner.

career.upright: A dream job that feels like a family. You are working in a place that shares your values.
career.reversed: Work-life conflict. Your career is taking too much time away from your loved ones.

financial.upright: Financial security that benefits the whole family. Long-term stability and abundance.
financial.reversed: Disagreements about money within the family. Financial instability at home.

wellbeing.upright: A sense of wholeness. Your physical health is supported by your happy home life.
wellbeing.reversed: Emotional stress at home is causing physical symptoms. Seek harmony.

name: Page of Cups
full_description: The Page of Cups shows a young man holding a golden cup, surprised to see a fish popping its head out of it. This represents the unexpected nature of inspiration and the stirrings of the subconscious. The Page is a dreamer, someone who is beginning to explore the vast ocean of their emotions. This card often brings news of a birth, a wedding, or a new creative project. It is an invitation to stay open to the 'magic' of life and to embrace your sensitive side without judgment. It suggests that a message is coming—perhaps one that touches your heart or sparks a new, imaginative idea.
upright_short_meaning: A new creative or emotional message is coming. Stay open to surprises.
reversed_short_meaning: You might be oversensitive or facing a creative block. Don't let doubt stop you.

love.upright: A new crush, a sweet message, or an invitation to a romantic event.
love.reversed: Childish behavior in love or an emotional message that causes confusion.

career.upright: A new project that requires creativity. Trust your artistic instincts.
career.reversed: Feeling uninspired at work or struggling to communicate your ideas effectively.

financial.upright: Good financial news or an opportunity to invest in something you love.
financial.reversed: Unrealistic financial dreams or making money decisions based on temporary emotions.

wellbeing.upright: Emotional healing through art or journaling. Listen to your dreams.
wellbeing.reversed: Escapism or ignoring physical health because you are lost in your feelings.

name: Knight of Cups
full_description: The Knight of Cups is the 'Prince Charming' of the Tarot. He sits on a white horse, moving slowly and gracefully, holding a cup as if it were a holy grail. Unlike the other knights, he is not driven by action or conflict, but by emotion and beauty. He is a messenger of romance and a visionary. When this card appears, it suggests that you are being invited to follow your heart. However, it also warns of being 'in love with love'—getting so lost in the fantasy that you lose touch with reality. He brings an energy of refinement, poetic expression, and the pursuit of a dream.
upright_short_meaning: Follow your heart. A charming opportunity or romantic offer is approaching.
reversed_short_meaning: Someone may be inconsistent or acting on unrealistic fantasies. Beware of 'ghosting.'

love.upright: A romantic proposal or a charming new partner. True emotional connection.
love.reversed: A partner who is hot and cold. Emotional manipulation or unrequited love.

career.upright: A creative career path or a job that aligns with your passions. Diplomatic success.
career.reversed: Feeling disillusioned at work. A project that looked good on paper but lacks substance.

financial.upright: Following your intuition in money matters. A profitable and creative venture.
financial.reversed: Financial disappointment caused by trusting someone too charming but unreliable.

wellbeing.upright: Finding balance through emotional expression and peace of mind.
wellbeing.reversed: Mental health struggles caused by mood swings or living in a fantasy world.

name: Queen of Cups
full_description: The Queen of Cups sits on a throne by the sea, gazing intensely at a closed cup. She is the embodiment of emotional intelligence and psychic ability. She feels the emotions of everyone around her and offers a safe, nurturing space for healing. This card represents a person (or an energy within you) that is deeply intuitive, empathetic, and stable. She doesn't need to speak to understand; she knows. The Queen reminds you to trust your inner voice and to treat yourself and others with profound kindness. She is the 'calm in the storm' who masters her emotions without being overwhelmed by them.
upright_short_meaning: Trust your intuition and lead with compassion. You are emotionally secure.
reversed_short_meaning: You may be feeling emotionally drained by others or becoming too dependent on someone.

love.upright: A deep, nurturing, and soulful love. You are very in tune with your partner.
love.reversed: Emotional insecurity or being too smothering. Lack of boundaries in love.

career.upright: A career in healing, art, or counseling. You are valued for your empathy.
career.reversed: Feeling overwhelmed by the emotions of coworkers. Difficulty staying professional.

financial.upright: Using your intuition to manage money. Financial security through wisdom.
financial.reversed: Financial stress caused by over-giving to others or lack of self-care.

wellbeing.upright: Excellent emotional health. You are deeply connected to your body's needs.
wellbeing.reversed: Feeling emotionally unstable. You need to set boundaries to protect your energy.

name: King of Cups
full_description: The King of Cups sits on a throne that floats upon the turbulent sea, yet he remains perfectly still. He represents the mastery of the emotional world. He has the same depth as the Queen, but he adds the element of control and leadership. This King does not let his feelings carry him away; he uses them as a guide for his wisdom and authority. He is a peacemaker and a diplomat. When he appears, he suggests that you need to stay calm and balanced, even if the world around you is chaotic. He is the father figure who provides emotional security and sound, compassionate advice.
upright_short_meaning: Master your emotions and stay balanced. Lead with wisdom and kindness.
reversed_short_meaning: Beware of someone using their emotions to control you. Stay grounded.

love.upright: A stable, mature, and deeply loving partner. Emotional security in a bond.
love.reversed: A partner who is emotionally distant or uses 'the silent treatment' to control.

career.upright: A calm and supportive boss. Success through diplomacy and emotional intelligence.
career.reversed: A workplace with hidden agendas or a boss who is emotionally volatile.

financial.upright: Wise and balanced financial decisions. You are in control of your wealth.
financial.reversed: Financial loss due to emotional instability or being manipulated by others.

wellbeing.upright: Strong mental health. You have found a way to balance your heart and mind.
wellbeing.reversed: Emotional exhaustion. You are suppressing your feelings until they explode.

name: Ace of Swords
full_description: The Ace of Swords shows a hand emerging from a cloud, gripping a double-edged sword that pierces a golden crown. This card is the ultimate symbol of mental power and the 'Aha!' moment of clarity. It represents a breakthrough where the fog of confusion is suddenly sliced through by the truth. While the Swords suit is often associated with struggle, the Ace is purely about the power of the mind and the sword of justice. It suggests that you have the intellectual strength to cut away what is unnecessary and see the core of a situation. It is a 'green light' for new ideas and logical decisions.
upright_short_meaning: A breakthrough in thinking. The truth is becoming clear. Take decisive action.
reversed_short_meaning: Your thinking is clouded. Avoid making major decisions until you have more clarity.

love.upright: An honest conversation that clears the air. A new intellectual connection.
love.reversed: Misunderstandings or harsh words. You are not seeing the truth in your relationship.

career.upright: A brilliant new idea or a successful communication project. Success through logic.
career.reversed: A project is stalled due to a lack of clear goals or confusing instructions.

financial.upright: A clear financial plan. You have the facts you need to make a good investment.
financial.reversed: Confusing financial details. Don't sign anything until you understand the fine print.

wellbeing.upright: Mental clarity leads to better health choices. A successful medical diagnosis.
wellbeing.reversed: Mental stress and confusion. Your thoughts are making you feel physically ill.

name: Two of Swords
full_description: The Two of Swords shows a blindfolded woman sitting with two heavy swords crossed over her chest. She is at a stalemate, unable or unwilling to make a choice. The blindfold suggests that she is ignoring the facts or trying to decide using only her mind, while ignoring her heart. This card represents a difficult crossroads where you feel stuck between two equally challenging options. It often appears when you are trying to avoid a painful truth or a necessary conflict. The message of this card is that you cannot stay in this position forever; eventually, you must take off the blindfold and face the reality of your choice.
upright_short_meaning: You are at a crossroads. Stop avoiding the choice and face the situation.
reversed_short_meaning: The stalemate is breaking, but you may feel overwhelmed by the information coming in.

love.upright: Avoiding a difficult conversation in your relationship. A temporary emotional block.
love.reversed: The truth is coming out, but it may cause conflict. No more hiding from feelings.

career.upright: Being stuck between two jobs or projects. You are refusing to pick a side.
career.reversed: A difficult decision at work is finally made, though it may be stressful.

financial.upright: Avoiding looking at your bank account or ignoring financial problems. Stalemate.
financial.reversed: Realizing the truth about your finances and being forced to take action.

wellbeing.upright: Ignoring physical symptoms. Your mind and body are at a standstill.
wellbeing.reversed: Emotional release. You are finally addressing the stress you were suppressing.

name: Three of Swords
full_description: The Three of Swords is one of the most painful cards in the deck, showing a heart pierced by three swords against a backdrop of rain and clouds. It represents the sharp pain of heartbreak, betrayal, or a sudden loss. Unlike the Five of Cups, which is a slow mourning, this card is the 'sting' of the event itself. It is the realization that something has ended or that trust has been broken. However, it is a necessary card; the swords represent the mental clarity that comes after the pain. Sometimes, the heart must be broken to let the light in. It is a reminder that pain is a part of the human experience and that you must feel it to heal it.
upright_short_meaning: Emotional pain or a difficult truth. Allow yourself to feel the grief to heal.
reversed_short_meaning: The worst is over. You are beginning to heal and forgive the past.

love.upright: Heartbreak, betrayal, or a painful breakup. A period of deep emotional sorrow.
love.reversed: Recovering from a breakup or forgiving a partner. The heart is starting to mend.

career.upright: A loss at work, a failed partnership, or receiving harsh criticism. Professional hurt.
career.reversed: Moving past a career disappointment. You are finding peace after a difficult time.

financial.upright: A sudden financial loss or a disagreement over money that causes pain.
financial.reversed: Financial recovery after a loss. You are learning to let go of the stress.

wellbeing.upright: Physical or emotional heartache. Stress is impacting your physical heart.
wellbeing.reversed: Healing and recovery. You are releasing the emotional trauma that hurt your body.

name: Four of Swords
full_description: The Four of Swords shows a knight lying on a tomb in a church, his hands in prayer. Three swords hang above him, and one lies beneath him. This card is a call for a strategic retreat. After the pain of the Three of Swords, you need a period of quiet and rest to recover your strength. This is not a card of permanent ending, but a temporary 'time out.' It suggests that your mind is overloaded and you need to step away from the noise to find your center. It is an invitation to meditate, sleep, and allow your body and soul to heal in the silence before you return to the battle of life.
upright_short_meaning: Take a break. You need rest and mental quiet to recover your strength.
reversed_short_meaning: You are pushing yourself too hard. Beware of burnout and exhaustion.

love.upright: Taking a break from dating or a 'pause' in a relationship to reflect.
love.reversed: Returning to the dating scene too soon or being restless in a relationship.

career.upright: A sabbatical or a vacation. You need to step away from work stress.
career.reversed: Working through exhaustion. You are not taking the break your mind needs.

financial.upright: A period of financial stability where you don't need to make any moves.
financial.reversed: Restless spending or feeling anxious about money even when things are quiet.

wellbeing.upright: Deep rest and recuperation. Meditation is highly recommended right now.
wellbeing.reversed: Insomnia or burnout. Your body is demanding the rest you are refusing.

name: Five of Swords
full_description: The Five of Swords shows a man holding three swords with a smug expression, while two others walk away in defeat. This card represents a hollow victory. You may have 'won' the argument or the battle, but at what cost? This card warns of the consequences of acting purely from ego. It suggests that there is a conflict where someone is being unfair or manipulative. If you are the winner, you may find yourself alone. If you are the loser, you may feel betrayed. It is a reminder that some battles aren't worth winning if they destroy your relationships or your integrity. It calls for you to pick your battles wisely.
upright_short_meaning: A conflict where there are no true winners. Beware of a hollow victory.
reversed_short_meaning: The conflict is ending, but resentment may remain. Try to find a way to move on.

love.upright: An argument where words are used as weapons. A lack of respect in communication.
love.reversed: Reconciliation after a fight, but the hurt feelings still need to be addressed.

career.upright: Office politics or a cutthroat environment. Someone is playing dirty to get ahead.
career.reversed: Leaving a toxic work environment or deciding to stop engaging in office gossip.

financial.upright: Unfair financial dealings. Someone may be trying to take advantage of you.
financial.reversed: Recovering from a financial dispute. You are choosing peace over being 'right'.

wellbeing.upright: Stress caused by constant conflict. Your competitive nature is hurting your health.
wellbeing.reversed: Choosing to let go of anger. Your physical health improves as you find peace.

name: Six of Swords
full_description: The Six of Swords shows a figure rowing a boat across a calm body of water, carrying two passengers. Six swords are stuck into the boat, but they do not weigh it down. This card is about a necessary transition. You are moving away from a turbulent past toward a calmer, more stable future. It is not a happy, celebratory move—it is often a somber departure made because you have no other choice. However, the water ahead is smooth, suggesting that relief is on the horizon. It is a card of hope, reminding you that even if the journey is quiet and a bit sad, you are moving toward a better place.
upright_short_meaning: You are moving toward calmer waters. Leave the past behind and seek peace.
reversed_short_meaning: You are struggling to let go of the past. Emotional baggage is slowing you down.

love.upright: Moving on after a difficult relationship or a couple traveling together to heal.
love.reversed: Unresolved issues from the past are following you into your new relationship.

career.upright: Leaving a stressful job for a more peaceful environment. A smooth transition.
career.reversed: Feeling stuck in a career you want to leave, but you're afraid to make the move.

financial.upright: Financial relief after a struggle. Moving toward a more stable money situation.
financial.reversed: Financial problems are still following you. You are not yet in 'calmer waters'.

wellbeing.upright: Recovery after an illness. A peaceful state of mind is helping you heal.
wellbeing.reversed: Slow recovery because you are mentally stuck in your pain or trauma.

name: Seven of Swords
full_description: The Seven of Swords depicts a man slipping away from a military camp with five swords in his arms, looking back at the two he left behind. This is the card of the 'lone wolf' and tactical deception. It suggests that you may be trying to get away with something or using a shortcut to achieve your goals. While it can represent clever strategy and independence, it often warns of dishonesty—either you are being deceptive, or someone is being sneaky with you. It is a reminder that while you might succeed in the short term by avoiding confrontation, the 'swords' you leave behind may eventually come back to haunt you.
upright_short_meaning: Work smart and keep your plans to yourself, but beware of acting dishonestly.
reversed_short_meaning: The truth is coming to light. It’s time to come clean and face the consequences.

love.upright: Secrets or lack of trust in a relationship. Someone may not be telling the whole truth.
love.reversed: A partner confesses a secret or a period of dishonesty in love finally ends.

career.upright: Office politics or someone taking credit for your work. Be careful who you trust.
career.reversed: An unfair workplace practice is exposed. Honesty becomes the best policy again.

financial.upright: Be cautious of shady deals or theft. Keep your financial documents secure.
financial.reversed: Recovering stolen property or realizing you were being misled in a money matter.

wellbeing.upright: Ignoring health symptoms or trying to find a 'quick fix' that doesn't work.
wellbeing.reversed: Acknowledging the truth about your health and seeking real, honest treatment.

name: Eight of Swords
full_description: The Eight of Swords shows a woman bound and blindfolded, surrounded by eight swords. She appears trapped, yet if you look closely, the swords don't completely block her path and her feet are free. This card represents a self-imposed prison. You feel restricted by your circumstances, but the 'chains' are actually your own thoughts and fears. You are a victim only of your own perspective. It suggests a time of feeling powerless or stuck in a 'no-win' situation, but it is a call to take off the blindfold and realize that you have the power to walk away whenever you choose to change your mindset.
upright_short_meaning: You feel trapped, but the exit is right in front of you. Change your thoughts to be free.
reversed_short_meaning: You are finally seeing a way out. The mental fog is lifting and you are regaining control.

love.upright: Feeling trapped in a relationship or paralyzed by the fear of being alone.
love.reversed: Breaking free from a restrictive partnership or letting go of limiting beliefs about love.

career.upright: Feeling stuck in a job or powerless to change your career. A lack of vision.
career.reversed: Realizing you have other career options. Taking the first step toward a new path.

financial.upright: Feeling overwhelmed by debt or financial restrictions. A 'stuck' money situation.
financial.reversed: Finding a solution to financial problems. Realizing that you can improve your budget.

wellbeing.upright: Anxiety and stress making you feel physically paralyzed or trapped in a cycle.
wellbeing.reversed: Mental health improvement. Releasing the fears that were impacting your body.

name: Nine of Swords
full_description: The Nine of Swords is often called the 'nightmare card.' It shows a figure sitting up in bed with their head in their hands, nine swords hanging on the wall behind them. This card represents the dark night of the soul—extreme anxiety, guilt, and overthinking. The pain here is mental rather than physical; your worries are magnifying the reality of the situation. It suggests that you are losing sleep over things that may not even happen. However, because the swords hang *behind* the figure, it reminds us that our fears are often based on the past or shadows, and the light of day will soon reveal that things aren't as bad as they seem.
upright_short_meaning: Anxiety is overwhelming you. Don't let your thoughts create a reality that isn't there.
reversed_short_meaning: The nightmare is ending. You are finding ways to cope and the light is returning.

love.upright: Deep worry about your relationship or being haunted by past romantic traumas.
love.reversed: Realizing your fears about your partner were exaggerated. Emotional healing.

career.upright: Extreme work stress. You are terrified of failure or making a mistake.
career.reversed: Stress at work is subsiding. You are gaining a more balanced perspective on your job.

financial.upright: Constant worry about money that leads to panic. Financial anxiety is peaking.
financial.reversed: Finding a way to manage your financial fears. The situation is looking more manageable.

wellbeing.upright: Insomnia, depression, or severe mental stress. You need to reach out for support.
wellbeing.reversed: Better sleep and mental health. You are finally letting go of the heavy thoughts.

name: Ten of Swords
full_description: The Ten of Swords is a dramatic card, showing a man lying face down with ten swords in his back. While it looks gruesome, it represents the absolute end of a painful situation. You have hit rock bottom, and the only way left to go is up. The worst has already happened. The sun is beginning to rise in the distance, signaling that the darkness is over. This card is about finality—a betrayal or a failure that is now complete. It asks you to accept the defeat so you can finally begin the process of healing. The cycle is finished; do not try to revive what is already dead.
upright_short_meaning: The worst is over. Accept the ending and wait for the new dawn to begin.
reversed_short_meaning: You are slowly picking yourself up. A lingering pain remains, but the healing has started.

love.upright: A painful, final breakup or a deep betrayal that ends a relationship for good.
love.reversed: Surviving a relationship crisis. You are starting to recover after a total collapse.

career.upright: The end of a job or a project failing completely. You feel stabbed in the back by colleagues.
career.reversed: Recovering from a career disaster. You are ready to start over with a clean slate.

financial.upright: Financial ruin or hitting the absolute bottom of your budget. A total loss.
financial.reversed: Avoiding total bankruptcy or starting to rebuild after a massive financial blow.

wellbeing.upright: Total exhaustion or a health crisis that forces you to stop. You cannot go on like this.
wellbeing.reversed: Recovering from a severe illness or mental breakdown. Your strength is returning.

name: Page of Swords
full_description: The Page of Swords stands on a windy hill, sword held high, looking alert and ready for anything. He represents the restless energy of the mind—curiosity, new ideas, and a sharp tongue. This Page is a messenger of truth and a seeker of information. He may be young or inexperienced, but his intellect is sharp. He encourages you to be inquisitive and to speak your mind, but he also warns against being too blunt or acting before you have all the facts. He is the energy of 'mental growth,' where you are learning to use your logic to navigate the world.
upright_short_meaning: Be curious and stay alert. New ideas and information are coming your way.
reversed_short_meaning: Beware of gossip or being too critical. You may be acting without thinking.

love.upright: Intellectual attraction or a flurry of messages. A time of honest communication.
love.reversed: Mind games, petty arguments, or using words to hurt a partner. Lack of depth.

career.upright: A new project requiring research or communication skills. Being a quick learner.
career.reversed: A lack of focus at work or being involved in office rumors. Be careful what you say.

financial.upright: Researching new ways to make money. A clever idea for a side hustle.
financial.reversed: Financial confusion or falling for a scheme because you didn't check the facts.

wellbeing.upright: Mental alertness and a focus on cognitive health. Seeking new health information.
wellbeing.reversed: Mental fatigue or 'overthinking' yourself into a headache. Need for a quiet mind.

name: Knight of Swords
full_description: The Knight of Swords charges forward on his horse, sword drawn, moving with incredible speed. He is the embodiment of pure mental force and ambition. When he wants something, he goes for it immediately, using his logic and sharp intellect to clear any obstacles. He is brave and direct, but he often forgets to consider the emotional consequences of his actions. This card suggests a time of fast-paced change where you must act quickly and decisively. It is an energy of 'taking the bull by the horns,' but it carries a warning: don't let your speed turn into recklessness.
upright_short_meaning: Charge forward with your ideas. Be direct and decisive to achieve your goals.
reversed_short_meaning: You are rushing headlong into a situation without a plan. Slow down before you crash.

love.upright: A sudden romantic pursuit or an intense intellectual connection. Very direct energy.
love.reversed: Aggressive communication or a partner who is being cold and overly logical.

career.upright: Making a bold move at work. Fast progress and overcoming professional challenges.
career.reversed: Conflict with coworkers due to a know-it-all attitude. Reckless business moves.
